items.title: Emile Christian and Anthony Sbarbaro Interview, 1959-02-11
items.q: I was in Chicago just a couple years ago and I was with George Brunas' feelings every night, you know?

ctx.x: by the way, you're not going to hurt George's feelings by answering this because... Who's George? I mean, George Brunas' feelings, but how did George compare with Henny?
I don't think any... I don't think George played as good as Henry, but George is still a terrific trombone player.
That's what George says. George says that himself. His brother is... Henry,
